note: Combination bank for the Oracle. Each entry is an unordered card PAIR (a,b) and the synthesized story 's' it seeds. The order the cards fall in a spread bends the emphasis, but the core relationship holds. Use this with combinations.md (the synthesis rules). NEVER read a pair as 'a means X, b means Y' — speak the single story. 519 pairs; ALL 231 Major×Major pairs covered (every 2+-Major/structural spread has an authored link), plus a 'popular' set of iconic Major×minor and minor×minor connections. Extend further as desired. All names are canonical (see cards/).
